benchmark: fib(40) recursive — a CPU microbenchmark (function-call and recursion overhead), not a real-world workload
methodology: Best of 5 wall-clock runs per language. Turbo measured via `turbolang build` (turbo-aot, native binary) and `turbolang run` (turbo-jit, includes compile time) using ./turbo/benchmarks/run_comparison.sh; C with clang -O2; Rust with rustc -O; Go with `go build`; plus Node.js 22, Ruby 3.1, and Python 3.10. Every language computes fib(40) and prints 102334155.
note: Supersedes a corrupted, Turbo-less results file (the previous CSV had triplicated Python rows and matrix results that disagreed across languages). The multi-language run_all.sh harness in this directory does not yet include a Turbo runner; these Turbo figures come from turbo/benchmarks/run_comparison.sh and run_external_baselines.sh.
